newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends flat despite Liberal poll slide.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends flat despite Liberal poll slide.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended flat on Wednesday at 1.3824 (US$0.7233) from this morning's open and firmer from Tuesday's close of C$1.3842 (US$0.7224) despite polls showing slipping support for Canada's ruling Liberals ahead of an election on June 2. * A Reuters poll suggested the Liberals could face a minority government if the trend continued.
Analysts said the prospect of a minority government would add unwanted uncertainty to financial markets, especially if the Western Canada-based Reform Party formed the official opposition.
Critics have accused Reform of running a divisive anti-Quebec campaign.
A Reform opposition would press the national unity issue in Parliament and likely "hurt the Canadian dollar and all our markets," said Katherine Beattie, technical analyst at MMS International.
Traders said markets were bracing for further volatility on the release of the last Reuters-Zogby poll at 1200 EDT/1600 GMT on Thursday.
